Digital Asset builds the technologies that are reshaping the foundations of financial markets. Our mission is to create the world’s most trusted, privacy-enabled, and interoperable digital infrastructure for global finance.

At the heart of this mission is the Canton Network - the blockchain purpose-built for institutional finance. Uniquely combining privacy, compliance, and scalability, Canton enables real-time, secure settlement across multiple asset classes. Governed by the Canton Foundation with participation from leading financial institutions, it is the proven link between the promise of blockchain and the power of global finance.

Founded in 2014 and headquartered in New York City, with offices in London, Zurich, Budapest, Hong Kong, and Sydney- we are on a mission to transform finance- and that transformation is now playing out rapidly on the Canton Network.

If you’re interested in playing a crucial role at the intersection of traditional and crypto-capital markets and want to help bring the next trillion dollars of finance on-chain, join us.

About the role:

We’re hiring the first Analyst on our newly formed Operations team, reporting directly to the Director of Strategy & Operations. This is a ground-floor opportunity to help define how a fast-growing blockchain infrastructure company runs - from executive governance and cross-functional workflow management to the data and AI systems that support company-wide decision making.

You’ll work across Finance, Legal, Product, and Engineering, and you’ll have direct exposure to how a Series F, venture-backed crypto infrastructure company operates at the executive level. Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер - іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших.

Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти - це ключова цінність SKELAR.

Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями - і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів.

Зараз ми у пошуку Reporting Analyst - ключового спеціаліста, який відповідатиме за підготовку управлінської звітності, фінансового контролінгу та аналітики в секції Marketing&Supply.

Виклики, які чекають на цій ролі:
- Формування управлінської звітності по секції Marketing&Supply;
- Оптимізація процесів та розробка інструментів фінансового контролю для підвищення ефективності та швидкості;
- Автоматизація процесів за допомогою ERP системи, а також впровадження та ведення аналітичних дашбордів;
- Комунікація з внутрішніми відділами (казначейство, репортинг, податки, адміністративна команда) для забезпечення належного рівня інфраструктури, необхідної для безперебійного зростання бізнесу портфельних компаній.

Що для нас важливо:
- Досвід 2-3 роки (досвід роботи у Big-4 або міжнародних аудиторських та FMCG компаніях буде плюсом);
- Знання бух.обліку та сильні аналітичні навички;
- Високий рівень володіння Excel;
- Високий рівень мотивації та бажання розвитку;
- Високий рівень комунікаційних навичок;
- Відповідальність та уважність до деталей.

У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації:

- SKELAR Platform. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті - а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші.

- Нетворк та обмін досвідом як частина культури. Серед наших колег - кофаундери, які запустили не один бізнес, а також найсильніші спеціалісти на ринку. Тож ми маємо доступ до необхідної експертизи на відстані витягнутої руки.

Define the AI-Era Quality Strategy:   Establish the end-to-end quality framework across human agents and AI agents, evolving QA from traditional sample-based auditing toward continuous, AI-enabled quality management.

•
Lead Cross-Functional AI Improvements:   Partner closely with Data Science, AI Engineering, Product, and CX teams to turn QA findings into prompt refinements, model fine-tuning, and updated knowledge base inputs.

Qualifications

Experience:   4-6 years in technical program management, QA management, or AI/ML product operations focused on system reliability and evaluation.

AI Evaluation Expertise:   Strong operational knowledge of AI/LLM testing methodologies, prompt evaluation, intent recognition accuracy, and AI safety guardrails.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:   Exceptional track record of bridging technical AI engineering teams with business stakeholders and front-line traveler support operations.

Domain Empathy:   Deep interest in online travel, traveler behavior, and maintaining high trust across consumer-facing AI interactions.

Preferred Qualifications

•
Hands-on experience with modern LLM evaluation tools, annotation platforms, or customer service AI tools (e.g., Zendesk AI, Intercom, Salesforce).

Background in travel tech, e-commerce marketplaces, or fast-scaling consumer platforms.

title: Domain Advisor Consultant (Subject Matter Expert)

Location: Remote
The Opportunity: Define the "Ground Truth" for Generative AI
We are looking to engage elite Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to partner with us on high-impact AI evaluation and training projects. We are not looking for generalists; we are seeking established authorities-the top 1% in their respective fields-who are eager to apply their deep domain knowledge to shape the reasoning, accuracy, and safety of next-generation Large Language Models (LLMs).
This is a consulting engagement for independent professionals who want to help define what "perfection" looks like in their industry. You will not just be grading AI; you will be architecting the "Gold Standard" rubrics that teach models how to think like an expert.
Scope of Services & Deliverables
This engagement focuses on high-level advisory and specialized analysis. Consultants will operate under a Statement of Work (SOW) to provide the following deliverables:

•
Rubric Architecture: Review and advise on the quality criteria used to evaluate AI outputs. You will determine if the AI’s logic holds up to professional scrutiny in your field.

•
"Golden" Data Curation: Create, edit, or certify "Golden Tasks"-benchmark examples of perfect prompts and responses that serve as the ground truth for model training.

•
Expert Gap Analysis: Analyze model failures (hallucinations, logical fallacies) and provide technical breakdowns of why the model failed and how a human expert would have approached the problem.

•
Advisory on Complexity: Consult on the difficulty and nuance of specific prompts to ensure the AI is being tested against sufficiently rigorous scenarios.

Consultant Profile: Who We Are Looking To Partner With
We are seeking independent business owners, freelancers, and academic leaders who possess:

•
Elite Domain Mastery: Advanced degrees (PhD, MD, JD) or equivalent industry-recognized status (e.g., Senior Principal Engineer, Published Author, Award-Winning Creative).

•
Professional Autonomy: You currently operate as an independent consultant or freelancer and have your own workflows, equipment, and professional methodology.

•
Interest in Shaping Technology: While prior experience in AI evaluation is a bonus, it is absolutely not required. We want industry veterans who are eager to set the "gold standard" for how AI should operate within their specific profession.

•
Articulate Reasoning: The ability to not just know the right answer, but to articulate the reasoning process clearly in writing.

Engagement Structure & Compliance
This is a strictly non-employee, independent contractor opportunity designed for professionals who manage their own business operations.

• Engagements are project-based and non-exclusive , allowing you to continue working with other clients

• You have flexibility in how you complete deliverables , in alignment with project requirements

• Scope, timelines, and compensation are defined in advance for each assignment

•
Remote & Independent: You provide your own workspace and equipment.

•
Global Compliance: Candidates must be properly registered to operate as independent contractors in their country of residence.

Why Top-Tier Consultants Partner With Us

•
Intellectual Challenge: This is rare, cerebral work that challenges you to deconstruct your own expertise to train a machine.

•
High-Value Impact: Your input directly influences the safety and capability of models used by millions.

•
Flexible Revenue Stream: Supplement your primary consulting business with flexible, high-value project work.

Dnes budujeme novou generaci digitálních profesionálů: marketérů, designérů, vývojářů a tvůrců, kteří nechtějí jen práci, ale i dopad.
Naše hodnoty jsou jednoduché a žité: lidé na prvním místě, zvědavost, kvalita a zodpovědnost.
A jsme teprve na začátku.
Přehled role
Do společnosti XPUP hledáme zkušeného odborníka na OSINT a korporátní bezpečnost, který se připojí k našemu týmu jako lektor kurzu OSINT (Open-Source Intelligence) . Vaším úkolem bude připravovat a vést interaktivní workshopy, sdílet reálné zkušenosti z praxe a provázet studenty během celého studia. Pomůžete jim osvojit si dovednosti potřebné k tomu, aby dokázali sbírat, analyzovat a vyhodnocovat informace z otevřených zdrojů profesionálně, eticky a v souladu s právními normami.
Open-source intelligence je dnes klíčovou disciplínou v korporátní bezpečnosti, due diligence i vyšetřování. Tento kurz studentům poskytne praktické dovednosti potřebné k efektivní práci s OSINT a SOCMINT nástroji - od sběru dat ze sociálních sítí a veřejných registrů přes analýzu Dark Webu až po pokročilou síťovou rekognoskaci a geolokaci. Prostřednictvím praktických cvičení a reálných scénářů se studenti naučí pracovat s moderními nástroji i AI automatizací, porozumí etickým a právním hranicím OSINT a osvojí si zásady bezpečné a zodpovědné práce s informacemi.

• Podporovat, motivovat a provázet studenty během celého vzdělávacího procesu.

• Vytvářet inspirativní, otevřené a podporující prostředí, které podněcuje aktivní zapojení, spolupráci a sdílení zkušeností.

• Průběžně sledovat nové trendy v oblasti moderního pracovního prostředí a začleňovat aktuální poznatky, technologie a osvědčené postupy do výuky.

Requirements

title: Market Curation Editor (Culture)
description:
The Opportunity
As a Market Curation Editor for Culture, you'll support the Product Data Operations team supporting a new social-predictions app moving through a beta launch. An automated pipeline drafts candidate prediction markets every night; you are the human judgment layer on top of it - deciding which go live, sharpening the ones that are nearly right, and catching the markets the pipeline missed entirely. This role calls for deep, current fluency in the U.S. entertainment and cultural landscape: its shows, its stars, its fandoms, and what people are actually talking about this week.
This beta is likely to extend into a planned Phase 2 regional expansion, alongside surge periods around awards season and major season finales. ** Will be removed prior to posting
What You'll Do

• Review a daily queue of system-generated culture markets against a fixed completion deadline.

• Assess each candidate for factual accuracy, clarity, and whether the resolution criteria can actually be adjudicated - often the hardest part in culture, since release dates move, awards categories change, and charts revise their methodology.

• Verify that open and close timing matches the real event: an announcement, a broadcast, a release, a ceremony.

• Make the relevance call - decide whether a market is genuinely live right now, or technically correct but culturally dead. This judgment is the core of the role.

• Confirm policy fit against community standards and content guidelines. Culture sits closest to the line on markets about real people - escalate anything touching private life, health, minors, grief, or unverified allegations rather than making an unsupported call.

• Approve, edit, or reject each candidate, recording a structured reason every time - this record is a product deliverable, not admin.

• Rewrite questions and resolution language for precision and for how fans actually talk, including fandom vocabulary a generic writer would get wrong.

• Author timestamped clarifications when ambiguity emerges in a live market, and handle settlement on markets with no authoritative feed.

• Run proactive gap scans across social platforms, fan communities, and entertainment press for culturally live moments the pipeline missed.

• Participate in weekly calibration reviews to stay consistent with published guidelines and fellow curators.

What We're Looking For

• 3+ years in entertainment journalism, editorial, social or community management, or a comparable role requiring current subject-matter expertise.

• Demonstrable current fluency in U.S. entertainment culture - television, film, music, celebrity, and fandom landscape - following it now, not historically.

• Working knowledge of the U.S. media landscape: which outlets break news, which are reliable, and which announcements are real versus speculative.

• Sound judgment on ambiguity: rumor versus confirmation, shifting release dates, contested awards outcomes, revised chart methodology.

• Ability to interpret sources quickly and reach a defensible determination.

• Exceptional written precision under deadline - able to write unambiguous rules that hold up after the outcome is known.

• Strong instinct for where a market about a real person crosses from public interest into private life, and the discipline to escalate rather than guess.

• Availability for evening, overnight, and weekend work around live events.

Nice to Have

• Current or former entertainment journalist (outlets in the vein of Entertainment Tonight, Access Hollywood, People, BuzzFeed News, or a relevant Substack).

• Experience trading on, participating in, or otherwise familiar with the workings of prediction markets.

• Prior work in a newsroom, or managing large social platforms for a news or entertainment brand with a hard daily deadline.

• Familiarity with content policy, moderation frameworks, or editorial standards - especially around coverage of private individuals.

• A track record of spotting trends and big

title: Consultoría para el Mapeo de Financiamiento para Bionegocios Amazónicos
description:
Términos de Referencia
Consultoría para la identificación y categorización de fuentes de financiamiento y fondos concursables para bionegocios comunitarios de la Amazonía peruana
Sobre NESsT

NESsT es una organización internacional sin fines de lucro con oficinas en América Latina y Europa y un equipo de liderazgo global con sede en los EE. UU.
El objetivo principal de NESsT es transformar vidas invirtiendo en empresas sociales que brinden empleo digno a las comunidades que enfrentan aislamiento, discriminación y falta de empleo, de habilidades y educación deficiente mientras son ambientalmente sostenibles. Creemos que las empresas sociales locales están excepcionalmente calificadas para transformar estas comunidades. Estas cuentan con la confianza de las comunidades y han creado negocios alineados con sus mejores intereses. Puede encontrar más información de NESsT en:
Sobre NESsT Amazonia
NESsT Amazonia es un programa que apoya los medios de vida de comunidades indígenas y la conservación de los bosques amazónicos, a través de dos estrategias: aceleración e inversión de impacto. En la fase de aceleración el programa acompaña a los emprendimientos de la bioeconomía, a aumentar el potencial empresarial ofreciendo: capital pre-semilla, mentoría de negocios, acceso a redes empresariales y mercados, diseño de tecnología y pruebas de mercado. Además, el programa trabaja con emprendimientos indígenas de manera integrada, vinculándolos con cadenas de valor sostenibles, proveyendo: pequeños subsidios, servicios empresariales y gestión de impacto.
Contexto y Justificación
Uno de los principales cuellos de botella para la sostenibilidad y el escalamiento de los bionegocios comunitarios de la Amazonía peruana es el acceso a financiamiento adecuado. Si bien en el Perú existe una oferta creciente de fuentes de financiamiento (fondos públicos concursables, fondos ambientales y de conservación, cooperación internacional, inversión de impacto, banca y microfinanzas, y premios), esta oferta se encuentra fragmentada y es heterogénea en cuanto a montos, instrumentos, requisitos, plazos y criterios de elegibilidad.
A ello se suma una barrera estructural: buena parte de estos fondos exige condiciones (formalización, forma jurídica específica, contrapartida o cofinanciamiento, garantías, historial financiero y capacidad de reporte) que muchas organizaciones comunitarias no logran cumplir. Los criterios de solicitud y los requisitos de reporte, cuando son complejos, limitan un acceso equitativo e inclusivo al financiamiento por parte de las iniciativas de base amazónica.
En este marco, NESsT requiere contar con un instrumento de trabajo actualizado, categorizado y accionable que identifique las fuentes de financiamiento y fondos concursables a los que pueden postular los bionegocios comunitarios amazónicos, con sus requisitos, montos, instrumentos, plazos y rutas de acceso, y que analice las brechas que dificultan dicho acceso. Este instrumento busca orientar el trabajo del equipo de NESsT y apoyar a los bionegocios de su portafolio en la toma de decisiones sobre financiamiento.
Conceptos clave
El desarrollo de la consultoría deberá considerar los siguientes conceptos:

• Socio-bioeconomía: mientras que bioeconomía responde a un concepto amplio y motivado por la innovación, la socio-bioeconomía se entiende como un modelo especializado adaptado para la preservación de las características ecológicas y culturales únicas de la Amazonía. Tiene como objetivo el balance ecológico, los medios de vida locales y la distribución equitativa; y combina conocimiento tradicional con la investigación científica.

• Bionegocio comunitario o de base comunitaria: cooperativas o asociaciones productivas de la industria de alimentos sostenibles y saludables, agroforestería, sociobiodiversidad, pesca sostenible y gestión de bosques comunitaria, que contribuyen a la conservación de los bosques y sus biomas, promoviendo la resiliencia territorial y aportando a la mitigació

title: FC Worker - CZ
description:
SKLADNÍK / FC WORKER (OPATOVICE NAD LABEM)

V Rohlíku je skvělá zákaznická zkušenost na prvním místě - a všechno to začíná právě ve skladu. Naši zákazníci milují, když jim kurýr přiveze čerstvé a kompletní jídlo přesně na čas. A na tom budeš mít z velké části zásluhu právě ty.

Jako Skladník v Rohlíku, budeš srdcem celého nášeho skladu. Budeš se starat o to, aby bylo zboží správně uložené, pečlivě zabalené a bleskově připravené k odjezdu. Čeká tě akční práce v moderním prostředí, kde technologie pomáhají a lidé si navzájem kryjí záda.

PROČ JE TAHLE ROLE ZAJÍMAVÁ

- Budeš mít přímý dopad - každá taška, kterou zabalíš, udělá někomu radost u něj doma.

- Moderní zázemí - pracujeme s čtečkami a chytrými systémy, které ti práci maximálně usnadní.

- Začít můžeš hned - nepotřebuješ roky praxe. Všechno tě na začátku naučíme.

- Rosteme společně - pokud budeš chtít, cesta k vyšším pozicím (třeba na vedoucího směny) je u nás otevřená.

- Přidáš se do týmu, který drží při sobě a zakládá si na tom, že věci dělá pořádně.

CO TĚ U NÁS ČEKÁ

- Příjem, naskladňování, kontrola a pečlivé chystání zboží podle objednávek.

- Práce s chytrým skenerem, který ti přesně ukáže, co a kam patří.

- Péče o to, aby jídlo zůstalo čerstvé, nepoškozené a v té nejvyšší kvalitě.

- Dodržování pravidel bezpečnosti a hygieny - zdraví, bezpečnost při práci a čistota jsou u nás na prvním místě.

- Spolupráce s kolegy na směně tak, aby celý sklad šlapal jako hodinky.

CO OD TEBE POTŘEBUJEME

- Svědomitost a spolehlivost - dorazit na směnu včas a dělat věci poctivě je pro nás základ.

- Fyzickou zdatnost - práce ve skladu je aktivní pohyb, občas je potřeba zvednout nebo přenést těžší tašku, či přepravku.

- Smysl pro detail - záleží nám na tom, aby v tašce nechybělo jablko a vajíčka dorazila celá.

- Ochotu pracovat na směny (včetně víkendů) - naši zákazníci jedí 7 dní v týdnu.

- Zkušenost ze skladu nebo práce se skenerem je výhodou/plusem, ale rozhodně ne podmínkou.

CO Z TOHO BUDEŠ MÍT

- Férovou odměnu - nástupní mzdu 32 000 Kč + příplatky za noční, víkendy, svátky nebo speciální prostředí. Protože dobrá práce si zaslouží jasné a férové uznání.

- Hrazené obědy ve výši 115 Kč.

- Ošatné ve výši až 1500 Kč za všechny odpracované směny v měsíci.

- Slevy na nákupy na Rohlíku - členství v Xtra zdarma a cashback na tvé vlastní nákupy.

- Lidský přístup a zaškolení - první dny s tebou projde zkušený kolega, který ti všechno ukáže a nenechá tě v tom plavat.

- Tým, který drží při sobě - budeš pracovat s lidmi, kteří jedou naplno, navzájem si pomáhají a táhnou za jeden provaz.

Zní to jako ty?

Jsi člověk, který se nebojí práce, má rád pohyb a chce vidět reálné výsledky za svýma rukama? Dej nám o sobě vědět a pojď s námi „upéct“ něco skvělého!

title: SWE, Data Ingestion
description:
About us    

Founded in 2017, Wayve is the leading developer of Embodied AI technology.  Our advanced AI software and foundation models enable vehicles to perceive, understand, and navigate any complex environment, enhancing the usability and safety of automated driving systems.

Our vision is to create autonomy that propels the world forward.  Our intelligent, mapless, and hardware-agnostic AI products are designed for automakers, accelerating the transition from assisted to automated driving. 

In our fast-paced environment big problems ignite us-we embrace uncertainty, leaning into complex challenges to unlock groundbreaking solutions. We aim high and stay humble in our pursuit of excellence, constantly learning and evolving as we pave the way for a smarter, safer future.

At Wayve, your contributions matter.  We value diversity, embrace new perspectives, and foster an inclusive work environment; we back each other to deliver impact.  

Make Wayve the experience that defines your career!  

The Role

We are looking for a Data Ingestion Engineer to help build and strengthen the data foundations behind Wayve’s self-driving technology.

At Wayve, we do not hand-code cars to drive. We train them to drive from data. That makes data ingestion one of the most important parts of our learning system. The faster, more reliably and more intelligently we can process real-world driving data, the faster we can improve our models and bring embodied AI into the world.

This is a hands-on permanent role for an engineer who enjoy solving practical, high-impact problems at scale. You will help keep our ingestion pipelines running smoothly, unblock critical data flows, and contribute to the long-term evolution of the systems that support annotation, data science, model training and evaluation.

Our data platform operates at significant scale, with over 500,000 hours of driving data, equating to 100’s of PBs. As our ADAS and autonomy work grows, we need ingestion systems that are robust, efficient and cost-effective. A single bad data segment can block a pipeline, build up queues and slow down downstream teams, so this role has a direct impact on how quickly Wayve’s AI can learn.

Key Responsibilities

You will work within the Data Ingestion team to improve the reliability, efficiency and throughput of the pipelines that move real-world driving data through Wayve.

• Debug and resolve failing or blocked ingestion pipelines.

• Investigate issues caused by corrupt, malformed or unexpected data.

• Design and implement more resilient pipelines so individual bad data segments do not block wider workflows.

• Improve how we handle varied data formats from partners, suppliers and third-party sources.

• Support orchestration across multi-step ingestion workflows, including dependencies, retries and queue management.

• Optimise Spark jobs and data-processing pipelines for throughput, compute efficiency and reliability.

• Reduce operational toil around failed jobs, stalled pipelines and manual interventions.

• Work on high-volume batch-processing systems where throughput, reliability and cost all matter.

• Help prioritise and unblock important datasets for downstream annotation, data science and model training teams.

• Partner with engineers across Data Platform and downstream teams to deliver both immediate improvements and scalable long-term solutions.

• Contribute to the technical direction, maintainability and operational excellence of Wayve’s ingestion platform.

About You

You are an experienced Data Engineer, Platform Engineer or Distributed Systems Engineer who enjoys working on large-scale production data systems.

You have seen how data pipelines behave in the real world: messy inputs, strange edge cases, corrupt files, stalled queues, unexpected formats and failures that only appear at scale. You are comfortable digging into those problems, finding the root cause and making syste

• Can balance people management with operational responsibility.

Nesto Group

Trusted by many of the country's leading financial institutions, we combine over 50 years of mortgage expertise with proprietary cloud and AI technology to transform the future of lending.

Life at nesto

We foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and creativity where every team member is empowered to take ownership, make an impact, and grow. If you're looking to solve meaningful problems alongside ambitious, supportive teammates, you'll feel right at home here.

You’ll be joining the Servicing stream , the product area responsible for the post-funding mortgage journey. title: Manager, Go-to-Market Enablement Business Partners
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Go-to-Market (GTM) Enablement develops the capabilities that help Stripe’s customer-facing teams deliver greater value to users. We define expectations for role excellence, build practical learning experiences, and equip managers to reinforce new skills and behaviors.

Enablement Business Partners connect our global strategy with the needs of specific regions, segments, roles, and business teams. They partner with leaders to identify performance needs, adapt enablement for the field, and embed learning into everyday coaching and business rhythms.

What you’ll do

You’ll lead a team of Enablement Business Partners responsible for deploying and adapting enablement across Stripe’s GTM organization. You’ll shape how the team works at scale, including how it prioritizes demand, responds to urgent needs, measures impact, and gives leaders visibility into progress and tradeoffs.

You’ll serve as a trusted partner to the Global Head of GTM Enablement and senior GTM leaders. You’ll combine field insights, performance data, and business context to identify needs, guide investments, and help customer-facing teams improve how they serve Stripe’s users.

Responsibilities

• Develop and execute an Enablement Business Partner strategy aligned with Stripe’s GTM priorities

• Lead and develop a team of Enablement Business Partners, strengthening their capabilities in consulting, stakeholder management, learning delivery, data interpretation, and change leadership

• Establish a consistent intake, prioritization, planning, and escalation model that balances strategic priorities with urgent business needs

• Partner with GTM leaders to identify performance and capability gaps, then translate them into targeted plans for specific regions, segments, and roles

• Coordinate the deployment and adaptation of global programs while embedding applied learning, manager coaching, and reinforcement into business rhythms

• Use conversation intelligence, competency data, learning signals, and business indicators to prioritize investments, evaluate behavior change, and make recommendations to senior leadership

• Build cross-functional partnerships and repeatable processes that clarify ownership, improve execution, and increase the impact of the Enablement Business Partner function

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 10+ years of experience in GTM leadership, sales enablement, sales effectiveness, or a related field

• Experience leading and developing a team in a complex, high-growth organization

• Experience building and scaling enablement programs or business-partner models across multiple regions, segments, or GTM roles

• Experience building prioritization and operating models, influencing senior stakeholders, and leading complex cross-functional initiatives

• Experience using performance data to identify skill gaps, guide coaching, and connect enablement to proficiency, behavior, and business outcomes

Preferred qualifications

• Experience in a quota-carrying sales or sales leadership role

• Experience enabling global teams and adapting programs across regions, markets, and cultural contexts

• Experience leading organizational change involving sales methodologies, processes, tools, or operating models

5. Risk System & Platform Development

• Lead the design of scalable risk infrastructure, including rule engines, decision engines, and case management systems

• Build unified systems that support fraud, AML, and fund flow monitoring

• Drive real-time decisioning and reduce reliance on manual processes

6. Data-driven Optimization

• Identify emerging fraud and AML typologies using data analysis

• Define and track key metrics (fraud loss, detection rate, false positives, operational efficiency)

• Implement testing frameworks (A/B testing, rule tuning, segmentation)

7. Team Leadership & Cross-regional Collaboration

• Build and lead teams across risk strategy, fraud operations, and AML operations

• Work closely with PH Risk & AML team for execution and local alignment

• Partner with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Operations globally

Requirements

Experience

• 8+ years in fraud risk, AML, payments risk, or risk strategy , with 3+ years in leadership

• Strong experience in payments, crypto exchanges, or fintech platforms

• Proven experience managing fiat transaction risk and/or payment fraud

Core Competencies

• Deep expertise in anti-fraud (ATO, payment fraud, scams) and AML

• Strong understanding of fiat transaction flows, payment systems, and risk controls

• Ability to trace fund flows across fiat and crypto and identify suspicious patterns

• Experience making or guiding account-level risk decisions (block/freeze/restrict)

• Experience designing scalable risk strategies and rule systems

title: Content LiveOps Manager
description:
We've set the standard in kids entertainment.
Come help us raise it.
We're Lingokids , the #1 entertainment platform for young kids. Most kids content is designed to capture attention. We create experiences little ones genuinely love.
Everything we make is created in-house to be seriously fun, with the good stuff built in from the very beginning. We're KidSAFE certified, completely ad-free, and committed to giving families entertainment they can trust, with no compromise. Ever.
20 million kids come back to us every single month, and we’ve earned more than 50 awards along the way. Now we're going after something bigger: becoming the go-to entertainment destination for kids everywhere, and changing what content looks like for the generation growing up on it.
You in? Keep on reading.
What you’ll do
As a Content LiveOps Manager , you will build Content LiveOps from (almost) zero: there's limited live-ops cadence and an early playbook, so what you set up becomes the operating rhythm Lingokids ship from here on. There's a lot to unlock too. As we grow into the leading kids' entertainment platform for licensed IPs, every new IP adds another vein of live-ops potential (events, drops, tie-ins) nobody's tapped yet.

• You’ll own and run a weekly content release cadence: new games, new IPs, new content going live on a predictable schedule.

• Design, plan and run time-limited events as the program matures, eg: a themed weekend drop with its own promotional treatment, not just a content update.

• Define what a release needs beyond the content itself: teaser moments, custom or animated icons, countdown treatments, in-app announcements, comms, and work with marketing, engineering and design to build what makes that possible.

• Soft-launch new content and games, and own the process for how something moves from ready to live.

• Partner with the Content Experimentation team to test the variables that matter (event length, timing, locking, positioning, packaging) and use the results to improve the next release.

• Be accountable for whether releases actually land: on schedule, and with a measurable lift in engagement and retention.

What you’ll bring

• Direct experience running a content release cadence, live-ops strategy, or live-events pipeline, done operationally.

• Comfort with a weekly operating rhythm.

• Strong cross-functional coordination skills: you'll be pulling in engineering, art, and design capacity shared across a broader team, not a dedicated build team of your own.

• LiveOps and Performance Data literacy: you can look at a release's performance and know whether it worked, how to iterate, and why.

• Background in games where "what's live changes constantly" is a normal part of the job.

Nice to have.

• Experience specifically with time-limited or seasonal events (eg: a holiday tie-in, a licensed-IP drop, a themed weekend…)

• Familiarity with subscription or content platforms for a young or family audience.

English is a must: We’re a multicultural team providing a service in English , so while certifications aren’t necessary, fluency is essential. As a fully remote company, clear and effective spoken and written communication -especially in asynchronous, long-form formats-is key to collaborating successfully.
Life at Lingokids
📚 Career Growth: Your growth drives our success! We invest in your development up to €2,000 per year for books and training; so you can keep learning and growing with us.
🏡 Remote in Spain & Relocation-Friendly Work from wherever you’re most productive, whether that’s your home anywhere in Spain or our vibrant hub in Madrid . Not currently in Spain? We’d love to have you here! We actively encourage relocation for those looking to make Spain their new home base.
📈 Stock Options: Your contribution matters! You'll receive stock options , giving you the opportunity to own part of the company and share in its success.
🖥 Home Office Setup: Create your ideal workspace with a €400 allowance for setup
